annotations.title: utilpeek: generate lorem ipsum placeholder text

description: utilpeek: Generate seeded lorem ipsum or English placeholder text. For random values use generate_random. Returns placeholder text: classic lorem ipsum or English filler, in words (at most 10,000), sentences (1,000) or paragraphs (100), deterministic for a `seed` (echoed back). Input: optional `kind`, `unit`, `count`, `seed` and `start_with_lorem`; an empty body gives 3 paragraphs. Typically under 0.3 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day.

count.description: At most 10,000 words, 1,000 sentences or 100 paragraphs.
count.title: Count

kind.description: lorem (Latin-like lorem ipsum, default) or english (common English words).
kind.title: Kind

seed.description: Random seed (default 0): the same seed and settings give the same text.
seed.title: Seed

start_with_lorem.description: kind=lorem: begin with "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet" (default true).
start_with_lorem.title: Start With Lorem

unit.description: What `count` counts: words, sentences or paragraphs (default).
unit.title: Unit

name: text_lorem

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
